profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: Software developer with experience in a variety of languages, frameworks and tools. Most of my experience is working in the payments industry as a server-side developer, code reviewer, team lead, and for one project as one of the architects in addition to the other roles. I do have front-end experience as well using ReactJS, AngularJS (now obsolete) and SPA design for UI as well as experience developing PCI SAQ-A compliant browser SDKs for payment systems. I have experience in developing CICD solutions and deploying applications in platforms such as AWS, VMware Tanzu Application Service (Pivotal Cloud Foundry), and Pantheon. I also have experience in developing an API Gateway in Apigee. I have experience and strong familiarity in the design and implementation of microservice architecture and last but not least  I am well familiarized with secure coding and design to prevent vulnerabilities within my control, and vulnerability remediation and patching for vulnerabilities in legacy code bases or pulled in through dependencies.

positions.title: Contract Software Developer
positions.description: Trained team on writing high quality code as well as best practices when writing unit tests. • Automated report generation of Javascript/PHP code quality evals. • Automated integration and unit testing. • Developed a robust, modular integration testing framework with a project template allowing for quick deployment of new integration testing modules custom tailored for web apps via a project wizard. • Automated compiling of API documentation for the testing framework with accompanying HTML/PDF user manual compiled from a Markdown file containing extensive documentation on integration testing

positions.title: PHP Programmer
positions.description: Numerous contributions to Notre Dame’s CORAL ERMS project • Server-side optimization of massive report generation; achieved drastic reduction (~50%) of memory and processing requirements • Data visualization • Built multiple projects from the ground-up to partially automate cataloging of resource acquisition through the integration of multiple RESTful API’s with raw data read  from a WorldCat RSS feed

positions.title: IT Support Technician
positions.description: Workstation imaging/deployment, VOIP transitioning, data-gathering on campus WiFi coverage, training of new technicians, training documentation, troubleshooting various hardware and software difficulties experienced by students, staff, and faculty.

projects.title: CORAL
projects.description:
The team members I listed are those individuals I'm in direct communication with, there are many other contributors to this open-source project that I do not personally know.

I have contributed to the following sub_modules:
- reports
- resources
- auth
- usage
- CORAL_Addons

projects.title: WorldCatSimilarTitles
projects.description: PHP web app that takes one or more library classification numbers (of user selected type), and returns a list of related titles for each id in addition to a lookup to indicate which resources are already held by the configured library.
